issues.issue: Did the Immigration Appeal Division err in its discretionary decision on humanitarian and compassionate grounds under s.67(1)(c) of IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant argues IAD erred in assessing factors and discretion regarding deportation appeal.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent contends IAD decision was reasonable, properly considered relevant factors, and no reviewable error exists.
issues.result_text: Court finds no reviewable error in IAD decision; discretion was reasonably exercised.
